breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect instruction to calculate the boundary-layer thickness using the laminar correlation (δ = 5 x / sqrt(Re_x)). The ground truth correctly identifies that the Reynolds number indicates a turbulent boundary layer and that a turbulent correlation should be used instead.
